textLocation: Claude project only (holdout/PHASE-2-HOLDOUT.md). The text is NOT in this repository and must not be added before the exit check.
use: Phase 2 exit check only, 6 cases x 3 runs (playbook section 6 item 2). Exposed after use.

hashMethod.file: SHA-256 of the UTF-8, LF-terminated YAML block (5418 bytes), header comments included, with {DATE} placeholders unfilled.
hashMethod.case: Split the YAML on lines consisting exactly of '---'; for each case document, strip leading/trailing newlines, append one LF, SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes. {DATE} placeholders unfilled.

dateRule: At exit, {DATE} is replaced by the case's listed weekday falling 7-14 days after the exit check starts. Filling the date (and switching to the listed fallback place if witness certification fails) are the only permitted changes; both must be recorded.

lineage.onlyLogicalChange: required_claims[1] single-key mapping restored verbatim under existing approval; serialization is a derived rehearsal copy
